messages:
Aisha (Marketing): Heads-up: we need a short enterprise one-pager variant aimed at regulated industries for the upcoming benchmark webinar. Must include security, SLA tiers, deployment choices, and a quick inbound routing cheat-sheet. Due for review tomorrow.
Noah (Product): I'll paste the SLA bullets (enterprise tier): 99.95% uptime SLA + latency SLO options (standard, premium). Keep the exact SLO numbers high-level in the one-pager.
Tara (Solutions): Recommend a mini decision tree: Regulated data? -> yes -> Private or Dedicated; no -> Hosted or Dedicated. Add KMS/HSM and audit log icons.
Ben (Sales): Routing rules: regulated -> AE + SE; low ARR -> nurture; mid ARR -> SDR. Add HubSpot tags: regulated_lead, enterprise_interest.
Cam (Growth): We'll include this in the webinar confirmation email. Also suggested CTA labels: "Request enterprise consult" and "Start dedicated trial."
Aisha (Marketing): Benchmark notes: Callout A: "Dedicated: typical p99 ~ 150ms for 512-token runs on reserved pools." Callout B: "Hosted: p99 ~ 380ms on average; batching can reduce per-token cost ~20%." Add disclaimer: "Results vary by model and prompt."
Noah (Product): Include line: "Automated model routing and fallback keep applications functional during regional capacity events."
Tara (Solutions): FAQ: "Can we keep keys on-prem?" -> "Yes, customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) available for Private and Dedicated offerings."
Ben (Sales): Suggested follow-up subject lines: "Redwood enterprise brief: security, SLAs, deployments" and short: "Redwood enterprise snapshot". Also include sample email snippet for AE outreach.
Cam (Growth): Registration gating: Add single question "Do you need enterprise features? (SLA/private)" -> if yes, increment lead score and tag.
Aisha (Marketing): Layout: one column, hero line, three short sections (Security, SLA & performance, Deployment modes), 2 numbered benchmark bullets, footer with HubSpot routing snippet.
ops-bot: New doc created: /marketing/enterprise-regulated-onepager-draft-1769010001 (access: marketing, product, sales)
Aisha (Marketing): I'll assemble copy now, please drop any final wording changes here.
Noah (Product): Don't mention raw model internals or kernel tuning. Link to bench page for deeper metrics.
Tara (Solutions): I'll add 3 qualification prompts for the routing box.
Ben (Sales): Will prep HubSpot rule examples and paste into the shared doc.
Aisha (Marketing): Thanks everyone, I'll loop back with the design team once the copy is in. :rocket:
